predefinedQueries.queryString: select true as dettaglio, true as insert_missing_mins, true as segna_ferie, true as segna_permesso, entrasp.dynamo_employer(gdr.dynamo_user) as employer, gdr.giorno, gdr.dynamo_user, gdr.min_richiesti as minuti_richiesti,min_rendicontati as minuti_rendicontati, greatest(gdr.min_richiesti-coalesce(min_rendicontati,0),0) as minuti_mancanti from entrasp.giornate_e_users_da_rendicontare gdr left join entrasp.minuti_rendicontati_users mr on gdr.giorno=mr.data_rend and gdr.dynamo_user=mr.dynamo_user where gdr.dynamo_user='$dynamo_user$' and (gdr.min_richiesti-coalesce(min_rendicontati,0))>0
